mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and recessionary risks, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST rise for two consecutive months, or interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05) in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruptions and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in future growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising GDPC1, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls for two consecutive months, or interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and signal economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
